days.reasoning: S3 shoulder injection print Thursday (June/NGM26 basis clean; anchor 2.689, last-hour DOWN). Decision-legit pre-print consensus for the 04-24 report is +80 Bcf (TE final is a post-print frozen capture; the 04-29 pre-print snapshot carried no value - so 80 is used as trajectory, not a hard legit point). Prior print (0423, report 04-17): actual +103 vs consensus 94/96 = +9 loose (bearish surplus confirmed, PUBLIC a week). Building-surplus backdrop (L48 +103/wk, vs_5yr +111.8). PRE-PRINT OVER-EXTENSION GATE (daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate): (a) OVER-EXTENSION - the pre-print chain is NOT a same-side multi-day run: 0427 -3950 sell, 0428 +342 flat, 0429 +7783 buy = a fresh single-session buy after chop, not a stacked run -> does NOT fire. (b) COHERENCE - D-1 (0429) is a strong COHERENT BUY: session_signed_flow +7783, session_b 0.52 AND big_print_b 0.621 BOTH buy, phase_flow [53,3644,4086] accelerating buy, phase_b rising [0.484,0.512,0.543]; session and big-print AGREE -> does NOT fire. (c) surprise priced marginal (bearish surplus public but no fresh 1-week specific surprise). < 2 fire -> gate does NOT trigger; the full-band chain-sided call is EARNED because D-1 flow is COHERENT (the 0423-analog case). Chain-sided direction = the D-1 buy side = UP. This is genuine demand / short-covering into the print (qbid 0.462 = offers stacked, aggressor lifting them). Magnitude S1-void-DAMPED (deep shoulder, near-window ~8.6 gw-HDD mod_heat, weather band grants no size) but storage-Thursday up-sizes the print magnitude. Post-print delivery is unseeable blind -> scenarios: coherent buy deliver-and-carry = damped-band UP; a big bearish build could fade the pop. Held a real counter/fade tail but the coherent buy owns the sign UP.

days.reasoning: S3 shoulder injection print Thursday (June/NGM26 basis clean). Building-surplus backdrop intact. PRE-PRINT OVER-EXTENSION GATE (daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate): (a) OVER-EXTENSION FIRES - the immediate pre-print chain is a stacked same-side BUY run: 0505 +3258 buy, 0506 +2066 buy = a 2-day buy run (cum +5324) reversing the prior 2-day sell (0501 -3358, 0504 -3110); a multi-day same-side run into the print. (b) INCOHERENT D-1 FIRES (the decisive tell) - D-1 (0506) net session_signed_flow is +2066 (BUY) BUT big_print_b_share is 0.427 (SELL) and session_b 0.48 (sell-lean): the BIG PRINTS ARE SELLING INTO a net-buy tape = distribution; the net flow and the big-print side DISAGREE. (c) surplus priced marginal. >= 2 tells fire (a + b) -> GATE FIRES: do NOT emit the full-band chain-sided (which would be UP continuing the 2-day buy run); go TWO-SIDED / COUNTER-TILT - raise the counter-delivery weight, widen toward the turn, p50 moves OFF the buy-chain sign toward flat/counter. This is exactly the chain-through-the-print trap the gate guards: a naive net-flow read sees +2066 buy and rides UP; the DIRECT big-print side read (0.427 SELL) reveals distribution and flips the call to a fade. p50 mild DOWN/flat. Injection backdrop + big-print distribution favors the bearish counter-delivery; but genuinely bimodal (the small-flow buy could still carry). S1-void damps magnitude either way (deep shoulder). No fresh legit pre-print point consensus captured -> trajectory prior only; surprise SIGN does not sort the side.

inputs.d1_coherence: INCOHERENT (net-flow buy vs big-print SELL 0.427 = distribution)

rule_trace.note: (a) over-ext + (b) incoherent D-1 BOTH fire -> gate triggers; chain sign (up) is NOT emitted; p50 tilts counter/flat toward the turn
